Game Overview

Cosmic Dash is a runner title where navigate the cosmic expanse as a fearless cosmonaut in Cosmic Dash. Swiftly dodge or destroy asteroids with simple touch controls. Collect tokens to unlock advanced ships while the endless challenge intensifies. Master precision and strategy in this exhilarating space adventure, where distance traveled is your ultimate achievement.
